description: Stage 2 of validation: the version check at /results_version, which comes before every other check and reports E1441 alone, and versions that it leaves to the structural check.

cases.description: The version 0.2.0, outside the supported line 0.1.x: E1441.

issues.message: Version '0.2.0' at /results_version is not supported. This release reads version 0.1.x.
Version '1.0.0' at /results_version is not supported. This release reads version 0.1.x.

cases.description: The version 0.1.01, whose patch has a leading zero: E1441.

issues.message: Version '0.1.01' at /results_version is not supported. This release reads version 0.1.x.

cases.description: The version 0.1.0-rc1, which the pattern of the line does not match: E1441.

issues.message: Version '0.1.0-rc1' at /results_version is not supported. This release reads version 0.1.x.

cases.description: A version of 33 characters that matches the pattern of the line but is longer than 32 characters: E1441.

issues.message: Version '0.1.11111111111111111111111111111' at /results_version is not supported. This release reads version 0.1.x.

cases.description: An unsupported version in a document that also lacks 'created', has an unknown member and an invalid stream: E1441 alone, since nothing else is checked after it.

issues.message: Version '0.3.0' at /results_version is not supported. This release reads version 0.1.x.

cases.description: The supported patch version 0.1.12: no issue.
A version written as a number: the version check leaves it to the structural check, which reports E1401.
A document without results_version: the structural check reports E1402 at the root.

issues.message: The object at (root) lacks the required member 'results_version'.

cases.description: A document that is an array, not an object: E1401 at the root.
